newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania Central Bank forex reserves up at $1.01bln in Oct.
newsitem.headline: Romania Central Bank forex reserves up at $1.01bln in Oct.

text.p: The total foreign exchange reserves of the central bank of Romania (BNR) rose to $1.01 billion at the end of October from $703.6 million the previous month, BNR data showed on Friday.
BNR vice-governor Vlad Soare told Reuters that level was "beyond the expectations of the International Monetary Fund."

Under a loan accord with the Fund, Romania had to consolidate its foreign exchange reserves. But the Fund froze credit tranches to Romania earlier this year over foreign exchange market curbs and failure to keep inflation pledges.

The central bank ended a 1996 borrowing programme from the international markets. Over the past two months the BNR raised about $270 million in five-year Samurais and $175 million from a syndicated loan led by ABN Amro and Citibank.
The BNR was entitled to draw up to $1.5 billion from private capital markets this year. It has raised $1.4 billion so far.
Romania's foreign reserve assets of the banking system were $3.14 billion in October, up from $2.72 billion in September.

The end-October reserve assets figure includes gold reserves worth some $1.07 billion, Special Drawing Rights holdings of $3.0 million and the hard currency reserves of local banks and the central bank amounting to $1.65 billion. -- Luli Popescu, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
